message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible anywhere in the data acquisition or processing code paths shown.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code calls retrieval functions (retrieve_epigenomes_labels, retrieve_sequences, get_genome) without any visible checksum verification, signed URL validation, or pinned commit/revision checks for remote data sources.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch and saves/loads results as JSON files, but there is no loading of pretrained weights or serialized models with any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection is visible anywhere on the inference data-flow path; data is loaded from CSV and passed directly to model.fit/predict.

No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are passed directly to metric functions (roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, etc.) without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models are bioinformatics classifiers (epigenomics/sequence), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
